title: LinkedIn Creator Ranker Input
description: Pass a list of LinkedIn creators. Returns one row per creator with engagement velocity, total reactions, average reactions per post, top post, and posts-per-day inside a lookback window.

creatorUrls.title: Creator URLs
creatorUrls.description: List of LinkedIn profile or company URLs. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella/', 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/openai/'.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback window (days)
lookbackDays.description: Only posts published within the last N days are counted toward the ranking. 30 is the default.

maxPostsPerCreator.title: Max posts per creator
maxPostsPerCreator.description: Cap on posts pulled per creator. Higher values produce more accurate rankings but cost more compute.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel page fetches. Six is a safe default for LinkedIn.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
